WORLD’S POWERS
Five provisional families
Sources → practices

EARTH & GROWTH
Earth-elemental power
Organic life and spirits
Philosophy: growth

NATURE PRACTICES
Nature weaving
Herbal potions & poisons
Mending & healing
Auras through relics / totems

MARTIAL / COMBAT
Skill and strength
Training and weaponry
Bloody, brutal fighting

MARTIAL PRACTICES
Blades & hand-to-hand
Hammers & heavy force
Bows & ranged skill
Warriors and archers

SCHOLARSHIP / SCIENCE
Knowledge and experiment
Mathematics
Wealth & influence enable access

SCHOLARLY PRACTICES
Chemistry & alchemy
Electricity
Ratios, patterns & prediction
Research, equipment & expertise

Human impulses
Outside entities
Power with appetite

DARK PRACTICES
Vampirism & hunger
Curses: slow, powerful payoff
Great enemy harm / self benefit
Manipulation remains possible

SCAVENGING / COLLECTION

Recognise overlooked value

SCAVENGER PRACTICES
Salvage goods from junk
Appraise rarity & collect
Manage packs and storage
Full-height grid growth to right

SHARED GROUND
Alchemy bridges nature and scholarship. Items can combine families.
Storage is available across all families; scavengers specialise in it.
Names, access to power and exact rules remain open.

GRID IDEA · GROWTH
Totem empowers touching herbs.
Herb → mortar → potion.
Potion coats a neighbouring blade or heals its wielder.

GRID IDEA · COMBAT
Whetstone empowers a touching blade.
Blade strikes → shield reacts.
Bow gains preparation from an adjacent quiver.

GRID IDEA · SCHOLARSHIP
Reagent → catalyst → mixture.
Coil transfers charge to a linked tool.
Ratios or grid patterns could boost a recipe.

GRID IDEA · HUNGER
Curse gathers pressure in a vessel.
A blade feeds it through draining.
Release stored power as enemy harm or a self boon.

GRID IDEA · SCAVENGING
Sorter reveals value in junk.
Pack adds full-height columns to the right.
Chains cross the new boundary.

SHARED EFFECT TYPES · what an item changes
Families give flavour; any item can combine these behaviours.

ACT
Damage, heal, mend, guard.
Targets a crew member, enemy or item.
Example: potion restores health; kit repairs gear.

MODIFY
Empower, weaken, cleanse, apply a status.
Duration / stacks need limits.
Example: oil empowers one blade use; curse builds pressure.

PRODUCE / CONVERT
Create supply; turn ingredients into another resource.
Example: herb + bottle → potion.
Inputs are spent; output needs room.

TRANSFER / STORE
Send charges or resources to another item; keep them for later.
Example: coil → battery → tool.
Capacity limits the stored amount.

SPACE / ACCESS
Expand grid space, reveal properties or unlock access.
Pack adds right columns; lens appraises loot; a tool opens a container.

GRID CONNECTIONS · options
Touching neighbour, facing direction, row or linked item.
Sockets hold modifiers; an aura reaches a defined area.
Each item shows its targets. Exact ranges stay open.

WHEN IT RUNS · separate from effect
Round start, use, hit or reaction in combat.
Discover loot, inspect, collect, place or salvage outside combat.
A passive aura applies while its condition holds. Each item names its trigger.

COSTS & LIMITS · proposals
Charges, ingredients, storage capacity and per-event limits.
Players choose valuable items before salvage.
Receiving loot should not fire combat attacks.
Exact costs and automation remain open.

OUTSIDE COMBAT · LOOTING IDEAS
Discover → inspect → choose what to carry → place or salvage.
Families offer different ways to use the same find.

GROWTH · ORGANIC FINDS
Find herbs, seeds or organic remains.
Herbal lens beside a find reveals its uses.
Mortar + herb → medicine or poison.
Player chooses the recipe; ingredients are spent.

COMBAT · RECOVER GEAR
Find worn weapons, armour and trophies.
Tool beside a sealed cache could spend a charge to open it.
Repair kit + damaged loot → usable gear.
Keep the item or salvage its materials.

SCHOLARSHIP · ANALYSE
Find reagents, mechanisms or strange devices.
Lens beside an unknown item reveals a property.
Reagent + assay tool → identified material.
Could trade knowledge for safer choices.

HUNGER · CURSED FINDS
Find tainted relics or bound remnants.
Vessel could collect a remnant.
Seal beside cursed loot reveals or contains its burden.
Keep, cleanse or sacrifice it: costs remain open.

SCAVENGING · RECOGNISE VALUE
Find goods among junk and dungeon debris.
Sorter beside selected junk → useful parts.
Appraisal reveals a rare component.
Pack creates space; player chooses what deserves it.

LOOT → GRID · possible first interaction
Select a find → inspect → choose Keep, Place or Salvage.
Example: find herb + empty bottle → place beside mortar → brew → store potion.
Full grid: rearrange, use a pack, leave a find or choose something to salvage.
Feedback: show affected cells, preview result / cost, animate transfer, update quantities.
Discovery rules, rarity, sockets on found items and charges remain open.

VISUAL ITEM CARDS · early concept
Art + icon stats + rules + a small grid example.
assets/concepts/item-card-study.png

CARD ANATOMY
1. Name and family / item type.
2. Large item illustration.
3. Icon + value: damage, healing, charges, capacity.
4. Trigger + effect + cost.
5. Grid footprint and source → target example.
Keep icons paired with words.

DRAFT VALUES · OPEN FOR DISCUSSION
Dagger: 2 DMG, 1×2; left whetstone gives +2 next strike.
Brew proposal: 2 HEAL, 1 charge, 1×1; herb + bottle + mortar recipe.
Pack proposal: 1×2; adds one full-height right column.
Family is a setting tag; it does not lock who can use an item.
This image is a design reference, separate from implemented rules.

ICON VOCABULARY · rough
Sword = damage. Heart = heal. Arrow = empower.
Circular arrow = trigger. Cells = grid footprint. Gem = loot.
Bottle = charges. Expanded grid = capacity.
Later: shield = guard, skull = curse, linked circles = socket.
A stat row shows only the values relevant to that item.

FAMILY STUDIES · separate icon + editable details
Each emblem can be moved independently. Expand the cards as we develop each family.

EMBLEM LANGUAGE · editable design notes
Earth & Growth: rooted tree, leaves and stone; growth / organic / spiritual.
Martial / Combat: crossed blade, hammer and arrow; skill / strength / ranged fighting.
Scholarship / Science: compass, flask and lightning; maths / chemistry / electricity.
Dark / Hunger: fanged chalice and blood drop; vampirism / hunger / delayed curses.
Scavenging / Collection: pack, rough shard and gem; salvage / value / carrying.
Names stay provisional. Icons identify setting families; item use can cross families. Luck stays optional.

EARTH & GROWTH
Source: earth, organic life and spirits.
Philosophy: growth.
Nature weaving; herbs, potions and poisons; healing and mending; totems and auras.

MARTIAL / COMBAT
Source: skill, strength and training.
Traditional, bloody and brutal fighting.
Blades and hand-to-hand; hammers and force; bows and ranged skill.

SCHOLARSHIP / SCIENCE
Source: knowledge and experiment.
Alchemy, chemistry, electricity and mathematics.
Wealth and influence open access to tools, research and learning.

DARK / HUNGER
Source: human impulses and outside entities.
Vampirism, hunger and curses.
Slow payoff: great enemy harm or a powerful self boon.
Manipulation remains possible.

SCAVENGING / COLLECTION
Source: resourcefulness and an eye for value.
Salvage, appraisal, rarity and collection.
Packs and storage support the crew.
Luck is optional.
